# Evaluation Snapshot

## Prompt
Fix the source-surface list in an existing decision record.

## Expected selection
do_not_use

## Why
The source record already exists, so the work is correction rather than creation.

## Expected object
A deflection toward aoa-decision-correct because an existing source record needs repair.

## Boundary notes
This is not an aoa-decision-create case because the durable rationale note is already present.

## Verification hooks
- inspect the existing source note
- correct metadata in place
- rebuild local indexes and refresh or check the workspace graph
